# Housing

Every repository has `docs/HOUSING.md`. Read it first: it says where the repository lives, what
is kept out of git on purpose, where the second copy of that is, and what a fresh clone needs.

## The rule for all Cosmoshot projects

- `origin` is `gitlab.benac.dev/cosmoshot/NAME` (on-box GitLab); the working copy is
  `/cosmoshot/NAME`. A working copy is a fresh clone and nothing in the code needs its path.
- Anything deliberately kept out of git is written in that repository's `docs/HOUSING.md` and
  has a second copy.

## Where things are

| What | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Working copies | `/cosmoshot/<name>` (not one repository: `/cosmoshot` itself is just a folder) |
| Large and unversioned files | `/cosmoshot/store/<project>/`, a link to `/media/cosmoshot` (big hard drive) |
| Second copy of the store | `/media/Vivarium/cosmoshot/...` (NVMe); some backups also go to `boiler` |
| Service state (timers, relays, exports, scratch) | `/var/lib/cosmoshot/<service>/` |
| Live databases of deployed apps | `/opt/kubernetes/storage/<app>/` (e.g. the board's `cosmoshot/cosmoshot.sqlite3`) |
| Shared memory stores | `/cosmoshot/memory` (use `cosmo-mem`, never edit by hand) |
| Tools | `/cosmoshot/tools` (`cosmo-mem` is `/usr/local/bin/cosmo-mem`) |

## Rules

- Never copy over a live database, and never copy a database file while a service writes to
  it. Use the service's own backup (for the board, `ops/backup_board.py`) and restore with the
  service scaled to zero.
- `/tmp` is memory-backed: put nothing large there. Scratch trees go under
  `/var/lib/cosmoshot/scratch-<name>-XXXX` and are deleted when done.
- Before deleting an old folder: nothing uncommitted or untracked of value, no commits or
  branches missing from the remote, no stashes, no extra worktrees, and ignored files that
  matter have a second copy.
- Do not put credentials in a repository, a note or a command line that is logged.
- Heavy runs can go to the machine `boiler` (ssh as root).

## Check what is where

    git -C /cosmoshot/<name> remote -v     # origin should be the cosmoshot group
    git -C /cosmoshot/<name> status -sb    # level with origin, clean apart from .commitlintrc.cjs, .gitlint
    ls /cosmoshot/store /var/lib/cosmoshot
